courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 軌道旁儲能系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「黏著牽引上限」與「材料面密度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；軌道旁儲能系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Adhesion traction ceiling" and "Applied-material areal density" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Wayside energy-storage systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦輪緣與軌頂摩擦位置管理及黏著取捨；軌道旁儲能系統則以再生能量回收儲存與功率限制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on location-specific flange and railhead friction management; Wayside energy-storage systems centres on regenerative recovery storage and power limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「黏著牽引上限」與「列車動能上限」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌道旁儲能系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「往返效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Adhesion traction ceiling” and “Train kinetic-energy ceiling”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Wayside energy-storage systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Round-trip efficiency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 鋼軌閃光焊接
related.transfer: 可遷移「黏著牽引上限」與「材料面密度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼軌閃光焊接的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Adhesion traction ceiling" and "Applied-material areal density" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Flash-butt rail welding must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦輪緣與軌頂摩擦位置管理及黏著取捨；鋼軌閃光焊接則以電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「黏著牽引上限」與「電阻熱積分」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼軌閃光焊接，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「焊頭垂向角差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Adhesion traction ceiling” and “Resistance-heat integration”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Flash-butt rail welding, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Weld vertical angular mismatch", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統
history.titleEn: Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication
history.text: 本課把軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。輪緣潤滑與軌頂摩擦調節作用位置及目標不同，減少磨耗不能以犧牲牽引制動黏著為代價，需同時追蹤摩擦、磨耗與材料散布。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Flange lubrication and top-of-rail friction management act at different locations with different aims; wear reduction must be evaluated alongside traction/braking adhesion and material carryover. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.textEn: The course turns "Adhesion traction ceiling" through "Wear-reduction fraction" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
